title: Text2Dashboard：面向企业数据大脑的自然语言仪表盘生成治理型智能体架构
summary: Text2Dashboard 是一个 DataBrain 专用原型，通过可安装的 Codex 插件与独立 Agent Runtime，将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘。系统结合模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态与确定性 Hooks，实现审批、审计、检查点、恢复与故障处理。评估显示元数据任务 4/4 通过，SQL 任务语义全部达标，故障场景全部符合预期，但作者强调结果不证明生产可用性。
summary_en: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that converts natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. Evaluation on frozen real-DataBrain tasks showed metadata selection passed 4/4, all SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and all ten fault scenarios met specified outcomes, though the authors caution these small results do not establish production readiness.
